hints.content: On a  number line, numbers to the right are greater than numbers to the left.
The values of $\green{-1}$ and $\maroonD{0}$  are to the right of  $\redD{-3}$.
The values that make the inequality true are $\green{-1}$ and $\maroonD{0}$.
